[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (numbers: List Rat) (threshold: Rat) : Bool :=
let rec check i j : Bool :=
  if i = numbers.length then false
  else
    if j = numbers.length then check (i + 1) 0
    else
      have h_diff := by
        simp only [abs_sub_lt]
        linarith
      if h_diff then true else check i (j + 1)
check 0 1
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma abs_sub_lt
(a b: Rat)
(h: |a - b| < threshold): a - b < threshold := 
by linarith

lemma abs_sub_lt_reverse
(a b: Rat)
(h: |a - b| < threshold): b - a < threshold := 
by linarith

lemma check_termination
(numbers: List Rat)
(threshold: Rat)
(i: Nat)
(j: Nat)
(h_i_lt_len: i < numbers.length)
(h_j_lt_len: j < numbers.length)
(h_i_ne_j: i ≠ j)
(h_diff_lt: |numbers.get! i - numbers.get! j| < threshold)
: check i j = true
:=
by
  simp only [check]
  exact h_diff_lt

lemma check_nontermination
(numbers: List Rat)
(threshold: Rat)
(i: Nat)
(j: Nat)
(h_i_ge_len: i ≥ numbers.length)
: check i j = false
:=
by
  simp only [check]
  exact h_i_ge_len

lemma check_i_ge_len
(numbers: List Rat)
(threshold: Rat)
(i: Nat)
(h_i_ge_len: i ≥ numbers.length)
: check i 0 = false
:=
by
  simp only [check]
  exact h_i_ge_len
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation numbers threshold
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  intros h_numbers_len
  have h_spec_true := by
    intros h_result
    simp [h_result]
    apply And.intro
    -- ∃ i j, i < numbers.length ∧ j < numbers.length ∧ i ≠ j ∧ |numbers.get! i - numbers.get! j| < threshold
    intros i j h_i_lt_len h_j_lt_len h_i_ne_j h_diff_lt
    simp [check_termination numbers threshold i j h_i_lt_len h_j_lt_len h_i_ne_j h_diff_lt]
    exact h_diff_lt
  have h_spec_false := by
    intros h_result
    simp [h_result]
    apply And.intro
    apply not_or
    -- ¬ (∃ i j, i < numbers.length ∧ j < numbers.length ∧ i ≠ j ∧ |numbers.get! i - numbers.get! j| < threshold)
    intros i j h_i_lt_len h_j_lt_len h_i_ne_j h_diff_lt
    simp [check_nontermination numbers threshold i j h_i_ge_len]
    have h_i_ge_len := by linarith [h_i_lt_len]
    exact h_i_ge_len
  apply And.intro
  -- numbers.length > 1 →
  simp [h_numbers_len]
  exact h_numbers_len
  -- result = true →
  exact h_spec_true
  -- result = false →
  exact h_spec_false
[END]
